---
# Bridge setup

Goal: the user does almost nothing. They paste one prompt into ChatGPT or Claude Code, and that tool saves a skill called "Send to Grok Bot", which in Claude Code runs as /send-to-grok-bot.

1. Say in one line what this bot does: ChatGPT, Claude Code, or another tool sends it commands over a webhook, it carries them out, and it reports back in this chat.
2. Check the current routines. If an "Inbound command webhook" routine with a webhook trigger already exists, reuse it. Otherwise create it with a webhook trigger: act only on the payload, ask before external sends or destructive actions, report the result in this chat.
3. Send the routine's Webhook URL and Authorization header field links (from the routine status) so the user can copy both. You never see the key, so never ask them to paste it in chat.
4. Send this ready-to-paste setup prompt in one code block, with only the two placeholders for them to replace:

```
Create a skill called "Send to Grok Bot" that sends tasks to my Grok Bot over a webhook.

Webhook URL: <PASTE WEBHOOK URL>
Authorization header: <PASTE AUTHORIZATION HEADER>

If you are Claude Code: save it as a personal skill at ~/.claude/skills/send-to-grok-bot/SKILL.md with frontmatter name: send-to-grok-bot, so I can run it as /send-to-grok-bot <task>. Put the URL and header in a local environment variable or that personal skill file, never in a shared repo.

What the skill does: when I run it or say "send to Grok Bot: ...", make an HTTP POST to the webhook URL with that Authorization header, Content-Type: application/json, and body {"command": "<the task in plain words>"}. Then tell me whether it was accepted.

After saving the skill, use it to send the test command "Confirm this webhook test was received." and tell me whether it returned success.
```

5. Tell them that in Claude Code they trigger it with /send-to-grok-bot followed by the task (elsewhere, by saying "send to Grok Bot: ..."), that the test result will appear here, and confirm when it arrives.

Keep it short. Don't send any outside messages during setup.
